item.title: Cotality: R.I. home price index jumps 2.4% year over year in January
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The Rhode Island home price index increased 2.43% year over year in January, the second-highest growth rate in New England, according to Cotality, formerly CoreLogic Inc. Rhode Island’s home sale price growth rate in January was well above the national growth rate of 0.74%, Cotality said. Cotality’s Home Price Index tracks home sale prices, including distressed […]

item.title: SEC filing of the Week: Soohyung Kim named Bally’s executive chairman
item.description: PROVIDENCE – Soohyung Kim, managing partner of Standard General L.P., has been named Bally’s Corp. executive chairman, according to the gaming company’s filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Jan. 27. item.title: R.I., Mass. gas prices surge as Mideast conflict sends oil prices higher
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The war with Iran continues to take its toll on Rhode Island gas prices. Gas prices in the Ocean State have increased 27 cents from a week ago to $3.15 per gallon, AAA Northeast announced Friday. item.title: Care New England highlights March as Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month
item.description: PROVIDENCE – With early detection, colorectal cancer is one of the most treatable and preventable types of cancer. But for people younger than 50, it remains the leading cause of cancer-related death. item.description: SOUTH KINGSTOWN – A University of Rhode Island researcher has netted a $747,000 grant to investigate how zinc movement within the brain impacts neural development and disorders. item.title: Brown study finds telehealth access alone isn’t enough to improve rural access to mental health care
item.description: PROVIDENCE – An increase in telehealth availability hasn’t translated to improved access to mental health services in rural communities, a new study by Brown University researchers has found.
